studies.study_name: APPROACH - A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Phase 3 Study of ISIS 304801 Administered Subcutaneously to Patients With Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS)
studies.design: randomised, double-blind (quadruple-masked), placebo-controlled, parallel-group; 52-week treatment period. A protocol amendment introduced an enhanced platelet-count monitoring and dose-adjustment algorithm partway through the trial (May 2016), so the trial reports platelet outcomes "before" and "after" enhanced monitoring.
studies.population: adults with FCS; 1:1 randomisation, 33 volanesorsen and 33 placebo in the full analysis set
studies.n_enrolled: 67 (ClinicalTrials.gov actual enrolment); 66 randomised / full analysis set, 33 volanesorsen + 33 placebo (EPAR Table 24 "Full Analysis Set (N = 66)"; NEJM "66 patients")
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: 65 for the confirmed-nadir platelet analysis in the EPAR (33 placebo + 32 volanesorsen with an evaluable baseline platelet count; EPAR Table 37 footnote c: "Baseline platelet count could not be obtained in 1 patient because of hemolysis"), which is why the EPAR volanesorsen percentages are x/32 (75.0% = 24/32; 46.9% = 15/32). The NEJM report of the same endpoint uses 33 + 33 (76% = 25/33; 48% = 16/33). Do NOT add CS7 (open-label extension) patients to this denominator.
studies.dose_regimen: volanesorsen 300 mg SC once weekly; dose pauses and reduction to 300 mg every 2 weeks permitted under the platelet-monitoring algorithm (dose reduction to biweekly in 10/33, 30%; dose interruption in 11/33, 33%)
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: "Table 37. Summary of Confirmed Nadir Post-Baseline Platelet Counts in Study CS6 - All Patients (N = 66) ... Patients with baseline platelet counts 33 / 32 ... Number (%) patients with confirmed nadir platelet count < 140,000/mm3 8 (24.2) 24 (75.0) ... A confirmed value was based on a consecutive lab value within 7 days. If that value was in the same or worse category the initial value was confirmed. ... If there was no retest within 7 days, the initial value was presumed confirmed." [Waylivra EPAR, EMA/180717/2019, p.92/121]. Corroborated in the primary publication: "confirmed nadir levels below 100,000 per microliter were observed in 16 patients (48%)" [N Engl J Med 2019;381:539, Results/Safety], and in the label: "confirmed reductions in platelet counts to below normal (140 x 10^9/L) were observed in 75% of FCS patients treated with volanesorsen and 24% of placebo patients" [Waylivra SmPC section 4.8].
studies.verification_locus: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 record fetched 2026-09-30: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT02211209 -> orgStudyIdInfo.id "ISIS 304801-CS6", officialTitle "A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Phase 3 Study of ISIS 304801 Administered Subcutaneously to Patients With Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS)", PHASE3, enrolment 67 ACTUAL, condition Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome, intervention Volanesorsen (otherNames ISIS 304801, IONIS-APOCIIIRx), start 2014-12, completion 2017-03-28. Publication verified via Europe PMC EXT_ID:31390500 -> N Engl J Med 2019;381:531-542, doi 10.1056/nejmoa1715944, Witztum JL et al. EPAR text verified from the EMA PDF (waylivra-epar-public-assessment-report_en.pdf), pages 85-87, 92, 95-99, 112-114.
studies.notes: FOUR SOURCES, ONE TRIAL - deduplicated per hard rule 2: the NEJM paper (SRC-BAA558), the EPAR CS6 sections (SRC-2A425E), the SmPC APPROACH paragraphs (SRC-1A5965) and a secondary citation in the ORION-1 safety paper (SRC-BCC78E) all describe NCT02211209. CROSS-SOURCE NUMERIC DISCREPANCIES on the same endpoint (not reconciled - all are retained as separate measurement rows): confirmed nadir <140,000/mm3 = 75.0% (24/32, EPAR Table 37) vs 76% (25/33, NEJM Table 4) vs 75% (SmPC); confirmed nadir <100,000/mm3 = 46.9% (15/32, EPAR) vs 48% (16/33, NEJM) vs 47% (SmPC). The EPAR narrative itself prints "24/33 volanesorsen-treated patients (75%)" (p.92), which is internally inconsistent with its own Table 37 denominator of 32 (24/33 = 72.7%). DEFECT in a curated row: TMSR1957 (secondary citation in Cardiovasc Res 2021;117:284-291) reports 45.5% for platelets <100,000/uL, which equals 15/33 and matches neither primary figure (EPAR 15/32 = 46.9%, NEJM 16/33 = 48.5%); treat it as a tertiary restatement, not an independent observation. DEFECT in a curated row: TMSR1890 (SmPC immunogenicity) bundles two trials - the label reads "In the Phase 3 clinical studies (CS16 and APPROACH), 16% and 33% of volanesorsen-treated patients tested positive for anti-drug antibodies during 6-month and 12-month treatment, respectively", so the row value 33% belongs to this trial (52-week) while the "16pct_at_6mo" element in its effect_vs_control field belongs to CS16/NCT02300233 (26-week). The row is assigned here on its primary value and should be split. The EPAR gives ADA 10/33 (30%) for CS6, slightly lower than the label's 33%. Nine individual-patient rows (platelet nadirs 8,000-75,000/mm3 and recovery times) come from EPAR Tables 40 and 41 and are CS6 patients inside this trial, not separate case reports. Body-weight subgroup rows (TMSR1850-1853) are EPAR Table 39 "Study CS6 Completers" (N=11 <70 kg, N=8 >=70 kg) - a completers subgroup of this trial, not a separate study.

studies.study_name: COMPASS - A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Phase 3 Study of ISIS 304801 Administered Subcutaneously to Patients With Hypertriglyceridemia
studies.design: randomised, double-blind (quadruple-masked), placebo-controlled, parallel-group; 26-week treatment period. Three arms: placebo; volanesorsen 300 mg weekly throughout; volanesorsen 300 mg weekly for 13 weeks then every 2 weeks (the biweekly step was introduced by protocol amendment in response to the platelet findings).
studies.indication: hypertriglyceridemia (severe HTG); a small number of FCS patients were also enrolled (5 on volanesorsen, 2 on placebo per EPAR p.101)
studies.population: adults with hypertriglyceridemia; 75 volanesorsen (25 weekly throughout, 50 switched to every 2 weeks after Week 13) and 38 placebo in the full analysis set
studies.n_enrolled: 114 (ClinicalTrials.gov actual enrolment); 113 full analysis set, 75 volanesorsen + 38 placebo (EPAR Table 30 "Full Analysis Set (N = 113)" and tabular overview of clinical studies)
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: 113 for the confirmed-nadir table (EPAR Table 38 "Study CS16 - All Patients (N = 113)"); within it the arm denominators are 25 (300 mg weekly), 50 (300 mg weekly then biweekly post Week 13) and 38 (placebo) - the 25/50 split is confirmed by the EPAR text ("n=50; TG -62% ... n=25; TG -78%", p.112) and is the only split consistent with the printed 2.00% and 6.00% cells. The mean-change-from-baseline analysis used smaller sets: n=25 (weekly) and "n=15 of 27 treated during end of study" (biweekly), EPAR p.92.
studies.dose_regimen: volanesorsen 300 mg SC once weekly for 26 weeks, or 300 mg once weekly for 13 weeks then 300 mg every 2 weeks to Week 26; dose pauses (10/75, 13.3%) and reductions to biweekly (29/75, 38.7%) permitted
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: "Table 38. Summary of Confirmed Nadir Post-Baseline Platelet Counts in Study CS16 - All Patients (N = 113)" [Waylivra EPAR, EMA/180717/2019, p.93/121; the table itself is an embedded bitmap in the PDF] with the accompanying text: "In study CS16 results were 28/75 volanesorsen-treated patients (37%) had a confirmed post-baseline platelet count below the LLN (140,000/mm3), and TEAE of 'thrombocytopenia/ platelet count decreased' was reported in 13 patients (17%)" and "Mean platelet count decrease was -52 (x10^9/L) at week 13, -65 at week 26 for 300 mg weekly (n=25) from a 238 (SD 69) baseline level" [EPAR p.92].
studies.verification_locus: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 record fetched 2026-09-30: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT02300233 -> orgStudyIdInfo.id "ISIS 304801-CS16", officialTitle "The COMPASS Study: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Phase 3 Study of ISIS 304801 Administered Subcutaneously to Patients With Hypertriglyceridemia", PHASE3, enrolment 114 ACTUAL, condition Hypertriglyceridemia, arms "Placebo" / "Volanesorsen 300 mg weekly" / "Volanesorsen 300 mg biweekly, post Week 13", sponsor Ionis Pharmaceuticals, start 2015-02-05, completion 2017-01-24. EPAR text verified from the EMA PDF, pages 85-87, 92-93, 99-100, 112.
studies.notes: Two EPAR rows that the curated file labels "Study CS16 ... 300 mg biweekly arm" (TMSR1788 mean change -72 at Week 13 and TMSR1790 -67 at Week 26) are taken from a restricted subset the EPAR describes as "a selection of patients from the 300 mg biweekly group (n=15 of 27 treated during end of study)", not from the full 50-patient biweekly arm - their denominator is 15, not 50. The EPAR also reports a 28% (21/75) vs 11% (4/38) composite platelet endpoint ("any 2 occurrences of platelet count < 140,000/mm3") on p.112, which is a different endpoint definition from the 37% confirmed-nadir figure on p.92; both are retained. One CS16 patient (nadir 41,000/mm3, onset day 51) appears in the cross-study low-platelet tables 40/41 and is assigned here.

studies.study_name: APPROACH Open-Label Extension - An Open-Label Study of Volanesorsen Administered Subcutaneously to Patients With Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS)
studies.design: open-label, non-randomised, single-arm (three rollover/entry groups), uncontrolled extension study; 52 weeks with an option to extend a further 52 weeks. Entry groups: patients rolling over from CS6, patients rolling over from CS16, and patients who were in neither index study.
studies.population: FCS patients; as of the 30 June 2018 EPAR cut-off, 67 volanesorsen-treated patients comprising 14 CS6-volanesorsen rollovers, 3 CS16-volanesorsen rollovers, 30 patients who had been on placebo in an index study and 20 fully treatment-naive patients (EPAR p.101). The label's "treatment-naive group" (n=50) is the 30 index-placebo plus 20 naive patients.
studies.n_enrolled: 68 (ClinicalTrials.gov actual enrolment, final); 67 volanesorsen-treated as of the 30 June 2018 EPAR data cut-off (EPAR tabular overview: "Volanesorsen: 67 as of 30 June 2018")
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: 66 in the label's platelet analysis (52/66 = 79% below 140 x 10^9/L; 33/66 = 50% below 100 x 10^9/L), of which 50 are the treatment-naive group (37/50 = 74% below 140; 24/50 = 48% below 100). OVERLAP WARNING: 14 of these patients also contribute to CS6 and 3 to CS16, so this denominator must never be added to CS6 or CS16. The non-overlapping union of FCS patients ever exposed to volanesorsen across CS6+CS7+CS16 is 86 (EPAR) / 87 (label) - see study_key volanesorsen-pool-fcs-CS6-CS7-CS16.
studies.dose_regimen: volanesorsen 300 mg SC once weekly, with dose frequency reduced to 300 mg every 2 weeks after 13 weeks per protocol; further dose pauses/reductions under the platelet-monitoring algorithm (dose reduction to biweekly in 6 patients, 21%)
studies.duration: 52 weeks, extendable by a further 52 weeks (open-label; EPAR data cut-offs December 2017 and 30 June 2018; registry completion 2020-01-15)
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: "In the open-label extension (CS7), confirmed reductions in platelet counts to below normal (140 x 10^9/L) were observed in 52 (79%) patients overall, including 37 (74%) patients in the treatment-naive group. Confirmed reductions to below 100 x 10^9/L were observed in 33 (50%) patients overall including 24 (48%) treatment naive patients." [Waylivra SmPC section 4.8, "Description of selected adverse reactions - Thrombocytopenia"]. Platelet monitoring frequency and per-patient trajectories are documented in "Table 41. Patients with Platelet Count Reductions < 50,000/mm3 and Recovery (CS2, CS6, CS16, CS7)" [EPAR p.100], whose four CS7 rows give nadir, initial protocol monitoring frequency, dose regimen at onset, time to decline and time to recovery.
studies.verification_locus: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 record fetched 2026-09-30: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT02658175 -> orgStudyIdInfo.id "ISIS 304801-CS7", officialTitle "ISIS 304801-CS7 The APPROACH Open Label Study Volanesorsen (ISIS 304801) An Open-Label Study of Volanesorsen Administered Subcutaneously to Patients With Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS)", PHASE3, NON_RANDOMIZED, masking NONE, enrolment 68 ACTUAL, sponsor Akcea Therapeutics, arms "Treatment-naive Group" / "CS6-Volanesorsen" / "CS16-Volanesorsen" with arm descriptions that name the index studies NCT02211209 and NCT02300233 explicitly. EPAR text verified from the EMA PDF, pages 85, 93, 100-103, 112; SmPC text verified from waylivra-epar-product-information_en.pdf section 4.8.
studies.notes: constituent_of is set to volanesorsen-CS6 per the lead curator's instruction for open-label extensions; the link is only partial, because CS7 also enrolled 3 rollovers from CS16 and 20 wholly treatment-naive patients, so CS7 is not nested within CS6. Its denominator is never added to CS6's. INTERNAL EPAR INCONSISTENCY, not resolved: p.103 states "still 9 patients discontinued due to platelet count decreases in OLE study CS7, with 4 patients with severe thrombocytopenia (as of June 2018)" while p.112 states discontinuation for thrombocytopenia was "9% (n=6) in study CS7"; both numbers are in the same document (the curated rows carry the p.103 value of 9). DATA-CUT DIFFERENCES: the EPAR (June 2018 cut, n=67) reports platelet count decreased in 12 (18%) and thrombocytopenia in 6 (9%); the current SmPC reports 16 (24%) and 14 (21%) for the same study at a later cut. Four severe thrombocytopenia cases in CS7 occurred AFTER the dose/monitoring algorithm was implemented, which is the regulatory crux of this record.

studies.study_name: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Dose Response, Phase 2 Study of ISIS 304801 Administered Subcutaneously to Patients With Severe or Uncontrolled Hypertriglyceridemia
studies.design: randomised, double-blind (quadruple-masked), placebo-controlled, dose-response (100, 200, 300 mg once weekly), 13-week treatment period; four patient cohorts across three treatment arms (including a Fredrickson type 1 dyslipidaemia cohort and a cohort on stable fibrate)
studies.indication: severe or uncontrolled hypertriglyceridemia (one cohort Fredrickson type 1 dyslipidaemia)
studies.population: adults with severe or uncontrolled hypertriglyceridemia; 64 volanesorsen and 24 placebo per the EPAR tabular overview
studies.n_enrolled: 89 (ClinicalTrials.gov actual enrolment); 88 per the EPAR tabular overview of clinical studies (volanesorsen 64, placebo 24)
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: TBD - the EPAR reports no group-level platelet denominator, distribution or incidence table for CS2. Only one CS2 patient appears, in the cross-study low-platelet tables (EPAR Tables 40 and 41). The CS2 volanesorsen arm (64) is therefore NOT usable as a platelet denominator.
studies.dose_regimen: volanesorsen 100 mg, 200 mg or 300 mg SC once weekly for 13 weeks (EPAR tabular overview)
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: Platelets were measured on a protocol-defined schedule and at least one confirmed event is reported, but no group-level platelet result is published for this trial. Evidence that the endpoint was assessed: "Table 41. Patients with Platelet Count Reductions < 50,000/mm3 and Recovery (CS2, CS6, CS16, CS7) ... CS2 | 49,000 | Q6W | Weekly | 102 | 11 | NA*" - i.e. nadir 49,000/mm3 under a protocol-specified initial monitoring frequency of every 6 weeks, 102 days to decline from >100,000/mm3 and 11 days to recover above 50,000/mm3 [Waylivra EPAR, EMA/180717/2019, p.100]; and "Across Studies CS6, CS16, and CS2, 5 patients had platelet reductions to < 50,000/mm3" [EPAR p.99]. Rated "partial" rather than "yes" because no denominator, no distribution of platelet counts and no placebo comparison are reported for CS2 - absence of further reported events here is NOT a measured negative (hard rule 5).
studies.verification_locus: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 record fetched 2026-09-30: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT01529424 -> orgStudyIdInfo.id "ISIS 304801-CS2", officialTitle "A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Dose Response, Phase 2 Study of ISIS 304801 Administered Subcutaneously to Patients With Severe or Uncontrolled Hypertriglyceridemia", PHASE2, enrolment 89 ACTUAL, condition Hypertriglyceridemia, sponsor Ionis Pharmaceuticals, completion 2014-01. EPAR text verified from the EMA PDF, pages 44 (tabular overview), 99-100.
studies.notes: Identity of the trial is firm (sponsor code CS2 maps 1:1 to NCT01529424 in the registry record). Only two measurement rows attach to it, both describing the same single patient seen in EPAR Table 40 (nadir 49,000/mm3, onset day 92) and Table 41 (time to recover above 50,000/mm3 = 11 days); they are two readouts on one patient, not two patients. The EPAR describes CS2 as following a first-in-human study CS1; CS1, CS4 and CS13 are part of the same programme (7 clinical studies in total) but carry no platelet measurement rows in this cluster.

studies.study_name: Waylivra EPAR pooled Placebo-Controlled Phase 3 Group (Studies CS6 + CS16)
studies.design: sponsor/regulator pooled safety analysis of the two placebo-controlled phase 3 studies combined into one "Placebo Controlled Phase 3 Group" (volanesorsen N=108, placebo N=71, total N=179); pooled proportions are CMH-adjusted by study, so the pooled percentages are NOT simple n/N. Includes the pooled exposure-response and body-weight regressions on the on-treatment maximum platelet reduction.
studies.indication: familial chylomicronemia syndrome (CS6) and hypertriglyceridemia (CS16) pooled
studies.population: all randomised patients of CS6 and CS16 combined: 108 volanesorsen, 71 placebo
studies.n_enrolled: 179 (108 volanesorsen + 71 placebo), which is CS6 (66) plus CS16 (113). This is a pooled total, not an additional study population - it must not be added to the constituent trials.
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: 108 volanesorsen / 71 placebo for the pooled adverse-event incidences (EPAR Tables 34 and 35); 105 for the two regression analyses of maximum platelet reduction against baseline weight and against steady-state exposure (EPAR Figures 20 and 21, "Studies CS6 and CS16, N = 105").
studies.dose_regimen: volanesorsen 300 mg SC once weekly (CS16 arm switched to every 2 weeks after Week 13), pooled across the two trials
studies.duration: 26 weeks (CS16) and 52 weeks (CS6); mean treatment duration 38.20 weeks (SD 16.09) in CS6 volanesorsen and 19.40 weeks in CS16 volanesorsen (EPAR Table 33, data cut-off 31 Dec 2017)
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: "Table 35. On-Treatment Adverse Events Potentially Related to Study Drug Experienced by > 5% of Pooled Volanesorsen Patients (Excluding AEs at the Injection Site) - Placebo Controlled Phase 3 Group (N = 179) ... Thrombocytopenia 0 | 4 (12.1) | 1 (2.6) | 10 (13.3) | 1 (1.6) | 14 (12.9); Platelet count decreased 1 (3.0) | 10 (30.3) | 2 (5.3) | 3 (4.0) | 3 (4.4) | 13 (14.4) ... Pooled proportion was adjusted by study using the CMH approach" [Waylivra EPAR, EMA/180717/2019, p.87]. Pooled platelet trajectory and exposure/weight relationships: "This decline reached a plateau where the group mean platelet count was approximately 30% lower than the baseline value" [p.93] and "Figure 20. Correlation Between Maximum Percent Reduction in Platelets During the On Treatment Period Versus Baseline Weight (Studies CS6 and CS16, N = 105)" with "A statistical association between platelet count percent decrease and body weight was observed (p < 0.0001)" [p.94].
studies.verification_locus: Waylivra EPAR EMA/180717/2019 (EMEA/H/C/004538), pages 85-87 (Tables 33-35, pooled column headers "Placebo (N = 71)" and "Volanesorsen (N = 108)"), 93-95 (Figures 20-21). Both constituents independently verified in ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02211209 (ISIS 304801-CS6) and NCT02300233 (ISIS 304801-CS16), fetched 2026-09-30.
studies.notes: NOT A TRIAL (hard rule 3). Constituent trials are individually identifiable and independently supported, and each already exists as its own record here: volanesorsen-CS6 (NCT02211209) and volanesorsen-CS16 (NCT02300233) - 2 constituent trials, no new trials created. registry_id and sponsor_protocol_id are left empty because a pooled analysis has no registry record; they are not "unknown". Consumers must not treat the pooled percentages (12.9%, 14.4%) as n/N: they are CMH-adjusted by study. The two regression rows (TMSR1799, TMSR1800) are on N=105, a subset of the 108 volanesorsen patients, not on 179.

studies.study_name: Waylivra pooled FCS safety set (all FCS patients exposed to volanesorsen in CS6, CS7 and CS16)
studies.design: pooled adverse-reaction analysis across the three studies that contributed FCS patients, de-duplicated to unique patients; the EPAR calls it "the most representative analysis set for the overall safety profile of volanesorsen in the intended target population". The EU label's adverse-reaction table is the label restatement of this same analysis at a later data cut.
studies.population: unique FCS patients ever exposed to volanesorsen across CS6, CS7 and CS16
studies.n_enrolled: 86 unique FCS volanesorsen-exposed patients at the June 2018 cut-off (EPAR p.85 and p.101: the CS6 volanesorsen arm of 33 plus the CS7 entrants who had not previously received volanesorsen - 30 index-study placebo patients, 3 CS16-volanesorsen rollovers and 20 treatment-naive patients; the 14 CS6-volanesorsen rollovers into CS7 are already inside the 33 and are not counted twice). The EU SmPC adverse-reaction table uses N=87 at a later cut.
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: 86 - the adverse-reaction incidences in EPAR Table 36 are computed on N=86 (e.g. thrombocytopenia 10/86 = 12%, immune thrombocytopenic purpura 1/86 = 1%); the label version of the same table uses N=87 and reports frequency bands rather than counts.
studies.dose_regimen: volanesorsen 300 mg SC weekly, reduced to every 2 weeks per the platelet algorithm (pooled across the three studies and across their differing durations)
studies.duration: chronic / mixed exposure: up to 52 weeks in CS6 and CS16 plus up to 104 weeks of open-label CS7 follow-up; EPAR data cut-off June 2018
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: "Table 36. Summary of adverse reactions in clinical studies in patients with FCS (N=86), data cut-off June 2018 ... Blood and lymphatic system disorders: Thrombocytopenia (10, 12%) | Leukopenia (2, 2%) | Eosinophilia (1, 1%) | Immune thrombocytopenic purpura (1, 1%) | Spontaneous haematoma (1, 1%)" [Waylivra EPAR, EMA/180717/2019, p.88]. Label counterpart verified verbatim: "Table 2: Summary of adverse reactions in clinical studies in patients with FCS (N=87) ... Blood and lymphatic system disorders | Very common: Thrombocytopenia | Common: Leukopenia, Lymphopenia, Eosinophilia, Immune thrombocytopenic purpura, Spontaneous haematoma" [Waylivra SmPC section 4.8].
studies.verification_locus: Waylivra EPAR EMA/180717/2019, p.85 ("safety data from patients with FCS from the pivotal and support studies (CS7 and CS16). This pooled analysis consisted of 86 patients"), p.88 (Table 36), p.101 (composition of the 86: "30 placebo treated patients, 14 patients previously treated with volanesorsen from study CS6, 3 previously treated in study CS16, and 20 complete naive patients"); Waylivra SmPC section 4.8 Table 2 (N=87) from waylivra-epar-product-information_en.pdf. Constituents verified in ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02211209, NCT02658175, NCT02300233 (fetched 2026-09-30).
studies.notes: NOT A TRIAL (hard rule 3). 3 constituent trials, all individually identifiable and independently supported, all already recorded here: CS6 (NCT02211209), CS7 (NCT02658175), CS16 (NCT02300233). This record is the clean worked example of hard rule 7: the pooled FCS denominator is 86 unique patients, which is deliberately NOT 33 (CS6) + 67 (CS7) + 5 (CS16 FCS) = 105, because 14 CS6 and 3 CS16 volanesorsen patients rolled over into CS7. The SmPC ITP row (TMSR1893) is assigned here rather than to a label-summary unit because the label's Table 2 is the restatement of this same pooled FCS analysis (ITP 1/86 = 1%, i.e. the "Common" band).

studies.study_name: Waylivra EPAR cross-study tally of confirmed platelet reductions below 50,000/mm3 (Studies CS2, CS6, CS16)
studies.design: cross-study case tally in the EPAR clinical-safety section: all patients in the placebo-controlled studies CS2, CS6 and CS16 whose platelet count fell below 50,000/mm3, listed patient-by-patient in Table 40 and (together with CS7) in Table 41
studies.indication: familial chylomicronemia syndrome (CS6) and hypertriglyceridemia (CS2, CS16)
studies.population: volanesorsen-treated patients in CS2, CS6 and CS16 who reached a platelet count below 50,000/mm3 (5 patients, of whom 2 fell below 25,000/mm3)
studies.n_enrolled: TBD - the EPAR prints no denominator for this cross-study tally. The constituent volanesorsen arms are 64 (CS2), 33 (CS6) and 75 (CS16); these are deliberately not summed here because patient-level non-overlap between CS2 and the phase 3 studies is not documented in the source (hard rule 7).
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: TBD - numerator only (5 patients) is reported; no denominator is given at this locus.
studies.dose_regimen: volanesorsen 300 mg SC weekly at onset in every tabulated case (CS2 case dose not stated beyond the weekly regimen)
studies.duration: 13 weeks (CS2), 26 weeks (CS16), 52 weeks (CS6); onsets day 51 to day 257
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: "Across Studies CS6, CS16, and CS2, 5 patients had platelet reductions to < 50,000/mm3, 2 of which were declines to < 25,000/mm3, 3 of which led to permanent discontinuation of study treatment (Table 40). In Study CS6, 2 of these events were considered serious (declines to < 25,000/mm3) and resulted in treatment discontinuation." [Waylivra EPAR, EMA/180717/2019, p.99]. The individual patients are tabulated with nadir, time to onset, duration, associated bleeding events and dosing action in Table 40 (p.99) and with recovery times in Table 41 (p.100).
studies.verification_locus: Waylivra EPAR EMA/180717/2019, p.99 ("Discontinuations due to decrease in platelet counts" and Table 40 title "Summary of Patients with Platelet Decreases to < 50,000/mm3 (Studies CS2, CS6, and CS16)"), p.100 (Table 41). Constituents verified in ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT01529424, NCT02211209, NCT02300233 (fetched 2026-09-30).
studies.notes: NOT A TRIAL (hard rule 3). 3 constituent trials, individually identifiable and independently supported, all already recorded here: CS2 (NCT01529424), CS6 (NCT02211209), CS16 (NCT02300233). Only one measurement row (TMSR1803, the 5-patient tally) is pooled; the per-patient rows from the same two tables are assigned to their own trials, because each row names its study. Confidence is medium only because the tally has no printed denominator, so no rate can be derived from it.

studies.study_name: Waylivra (volanesorsen) EU Summary of Product Characteristics - section 4.4 thrombocytopenia warning
studies.design: regulatory label text (EU SmPC special warnings and precautions); not a study and not an analysis of a defined population
studies.indication: familial chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS) - approved EU indication
studies.population: not applicable: a labelling warning about a patient characteristic (body weight below 70 kg), with no study population of its own
studies.n_enrolled: TBD - no denominator is attached to this label statement.
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: TBD - no denominator is attached to this label statement. The underlying evidence is elsewhere: EPAR Table 39 (Study CS6 completers, N=11 below 70 kg vs N=8 at or above 70 kg; mean nadir 76 vs 126 x 10^9/L) and the pooled CS6+CS16 weight regression (N=105, p<0.0001).
studies.dose_regimen: Waylivra 285 mg (volanesorsen 300 mg) SC once weekly for 3 months, then once every 2 weeks (approved posology)
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: "Waylivra is very commonly associated with reductions in platelet count in patients with FCS, which may result in thrombocytopenia (see section 4.8). Patients with lower body weight (less than 70 kg) may be more prone to thrombocytopenia during treatment with this medicinal product." [Waylivra SmPC section 4.4, "Thrombocytopenia"]. Marked "no" per hard rule 5: this locus asserts a susceptibility, with no denominator, no defined exposure/observation window and no measured platelet result. It is not a measured endpoint and must not be read as one.
studies.verification_locus: Waylivra product information (EMEA/H/C/004538), waylivra-epar-product-information_en.pdf, section 4.4 "Special warnings and precautions for use - Thrombocytopenia"; quote read directly from the fetched PDF on 2026-09-30. Quantitative support located at Waylivra EPAR EMA/180717/2019, p.95 (Table 39) and p.94 (weight correlation, N=105).
studies.notes: NOT A TRIAL (hard rule 4): an unspecified label-level warning. Only the single body-weight risk-factor row is assigned here. The other SmPC rows were deduplicated into the trials or the pooled analysis they actually restate (hard rule 2): the APPROACH paragraphs into volanesorsen-CS6, the open-label-extension paragraphs into volanesorsen-CS7, and the adverse-reaction table into volanesorsen-pool-fcs-CS6-CS7-CS16. The label dose is expressed as 285 mg volanesorsen sodium = 300 mg volanesorsen free acid, which is why label rows read 285 mg while trial rows read 300 mg - the same dose, not two dose levels.

studies.study_name: Crooke et al. 2016 - Integrated Safety Assessment of 2'-O-Methoxyethyl Chimeric Antisense Oligonucleotides in NonHuman Primates and Healthy Human Volunteers (human volunteer arm)
studies.design: retrospective integrated (class-level) safety analysis drawing on a sponsor-built integrated safety database; the human component pools 15 randomised, placebo-controlled, dose-ranging phase 1 studies in healthy volunteers covering 12 unique 2'MOE chimeric ASOs. Results are reported by pooled weekly-dose band, not by study or by compound. (The companion non-human-primate dataset in the same paper is out of scope for this human-grain registry.)
studies.compound: 2'-O-methoxyethyl (2'MOE) chimeric antisense oligonucleotide class pool - 12 unique ASOs, identified in the source only by molecular target (Supplementary Table S1)
studies.population: 750 healthy human subjects (179 women, 571 men), 84.4% white, age 18-70 (mean 41.3 +/- 13.0), mean BMI 26.0 +/- 3.3
studies.n_enrolled: 750 healthy volunteers across 15 randomised placebo-controlled studies (source: "The clinical study population of healthy volunteers was comprised of 750 human subjects" and "Treatment periods for the respective randomized placebo-controlled studies (n = 15) in healthy human volunteers ranged up to 6 weeks")
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: 733 in the Table 2 platelet-threshold analysis - the sum of the printed, non-overlapping per-band denominators (placebo 184; active bands 122, 113, 175, 43, 78, 18); the paper does not print this total. The Supplementary Table S6b mean-platelet analysis uses a smaller set, because a cell was only reported where it contained at least 10 subjects and at least 4 ASOs (per-band n 25-65 at Dose 6, and the >275-375 mg and >475 mg bands are absent from it entirely).
studies.route: subcutaneous and intravenous systemic dosing (pooled; the paper reports by weekly dose in mg, not by route)
studies.dose_regimen: pooled dose bands up to >475 mg per week; multidose regimens gave study drug every other day in week 1, with or without weekly dosing thereafter (Supplementary Figure S2); mean results are indexed by dose number (Dose 1-6) rather than by calendar time
studies.duration: up to 6 weeks of treatment; the over-time analysis included study data up to 10 days after the last dose
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: "in human studies, we observed no remarkable reduction in platelet counts over the course of treatment (Figure 4b) and no apparent dose or total exposure relationship (see Supplementary Table S6). The only incidence of platelet counts below 75,000 per microlitre occurred in a placebo treated subject (Table 2)." [Mol Ther 2016;24:1771-1782, Discussion; PMC5112040]. The endpoint was assessed under defined thresholds with a confirmation rule: Table 2 reports platelet counts below 75 K/mm3 by dose band on confirmed test results, and Supplementary Table S6b reports mean (SE), median, quartiles and min-max platelet counts by dose band at each dose number against a stated human LLN of 140 K/mm3 (Figure 4 legend).
studies.verification_locus: Europe PMC EXT_ID:27357629 -> Mol Ther 2016;24:1771-1782, doi 10.1038/mt.2016.136, PMC5112040, Crooke ST et al. Full text XML fetched from Europe PMC on 2026-09-30; constituent-study count verified verbatim in the Results ("Safety laboratory tests"): "Treatment periods for the respective randomized placebo-controlled studies (n = 15) in healthy human volunteers ranged up to 6 weeks"; population verified in the Results opening: "comprised of 750 human subjects".
studies.notes: NOT A TRIAL (hard rule 3), and OUT OF COMPOUND for this cluster - it carries no volanesorsen data; it sits in cluster_volanesorsen only because its Discussion cross-references the volanesorsen and IONIS-TTRRx phase 3 signals (those three rows are listed as unassignable). 15 constituent phase 1 trials are STATED but NOT individually identifiable: the source names no trial, protocol number or registry identifier, and identifies the 12 ASOs only by molecular target in Supplementary Table S1, so no constituent trial records were created (hard rule 3) and no registry ids were asserted (hard rule 1). CROSS-CLUSTER OVERLAP WARNING: this is one of a family of integrated analyses drawn from the same Ionis integrated safety database; a sibling analysis is curated in cluster_crooke2017_pooled (PMID 28145801 / doi 10.1089/nat.2016.0650) and another in this file (crooke2019-galnac3-integrated-hv). Subject-level overlap between these pools is likely, so their denominators must never be summed and they must not be counted as independent trials. SCIENTIFIC POINT this unit exists to carry: the only platelet count below 75,000/microlitre in 750 healthy volunteers occurred on placebo, while the >375-475 mg band showed a statistically significant mean decrement (207.4 vs 231.1 K/mm3, p<0.001) whose group minimum (147.0) still sat above the stated LLN - the paper's animal-to-human translation argument.

studies.study_name: Crooke et al. 2019 - Integrated Assessment of the Clinical Performance of GalNAc3-Conjugated 2'-O-Methoxyethyl Chimeric Antisense Oligonucleotides: I. Human Volunteer Experience
studies.design: integrated (class-level) safety and tolerability analysis pooling the randomised, placebo-controlled, dose-ranging phase 1 healthy-volunteer studies of 8 GalNAc3-conjugated PS 2'MOE ASOs; reported separately for a single-dose cohort and a weekly multidose cohort, by pooled weekly-dose band and as a "Total ASO" column
studies.compound: GalNAc3-conjugated phosphorothioate 2'MOE ASO class pool - 8 ASOs (ISIS 678354 ApoC3-L, 681257 LPA-L, 696844 CFB-L, 703802 ANGPTL3-L, 712408 HBVS-L, 721744 KLKB1-L, 757456 AGT-L, 766720 GHR-L)
studies.population: healthy volunteers in 8 phase 1 HV randomised controlled trials, one per ASO (Table 1 gives placebo/active/total per study: 18/49/67, 13/45/58, 12/42/54, 12/36/48, 14/42/56, 8/24/32, 12/29/41, 9/27/36)
studies.n_enrolled: 392 total across the 8 phase 1 HV-RCTs (98 placebo, 294 active; Table 1 "Total" row). The primary integrated analyses exclude ISIS 721744 (KLKB1, n=32) per Table 1 footnote b ("Data not included in primary integrated analyses"), leaving 360 subjects (90 placebo, 270 active).
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: 157 for the weekly multidose platelet analysis: Table 5 is titled "Incidence of Abnormal Laboratory Test Results in Weekly Multidose Regimen Cohort (N = 157)" and its Platelets row carries n = 36 placebo and 121 Total ASO, with dose-band n of 32, 38, 33, 12 and 6. The single-dose cohort is analysed separately (Supplementary Table S9 and Supplementary Figure S5) and its denominators were not captured in the curated rows; the two cohorts are different subjects and must not be summed.
studies.dose_regimen: single ascending SC doses, and weekly multidose regimens pooled into bands >0-10, >10-20, >20-40, >40-60 and >60 mg/week (4-8 SC doses over up to 6 weeks); GalNAc3 conjugation raises potency so the mg doses are roughly an order of magnitude below the unconjugated 2'MOE bands
studies.duration: single dose, or 4-8 weekly SC doses over up to 6 weeks
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: "Table 5. Incidence of Abnormal Laboratory Test Results in Weekly Multidose Regimen Cohort (N = 157) ... Hematology | Platelets, n: 36 | 121 | 32 | 38 | 33 | 12 | 6; <100 K/mm3, n (%): 0 (0.0) ... ; <75 K/mm3, n (%): 0 (0.0) ..." [Nucleic Acid Ther 2019;29:16-32, Table 5; PMC6386089], supported by the Results text "As can be seen, there were no effects observed at any dose level on the mean values of any of the analytes measured (Figs. 5-7)" and by Supplementary Table S5 (mean, median, min-max platelets by dose number and dose band) and Supplementary Figure S5 (individual platelet trajectories, single-dose cohort). The zeros are therefore ASSESSED zeros against stated thresholds with printed denominators, not absence of reporting (hard rule 5).
studies.verification_locus: Europe PMC EXT_ID:30570431 -> Nucleic Acid Ther 2019;29:16-32, doi 10.1089/nat.2018.0753, PMC6386089, Crooke ST, Baker BF, Xia S, Yu RZ, Viney NJ, Wang Y, Tsimikas S, Geary RS. Full text XML fetched from Europe PMC on 2026-09-30; Table 1 ("Evaluation of Eight Unique GalNAc3-Conjugated Phosphorothioate 2'-O-Methoxyethyl Antisense Oligonucleotides", columns "Phase 1 HV-RCT, n: Placebo | Active | Total") and Table 5 read from that XML.
studies.notes: NOT A TRIAL (hard rule 3), and OUT OF COMPOUND for this cluster - no volanesorsen data; the ApoC3-L member (ISIS 678354) is olezarsen, volanesorsen's GalNAc3-conjugated successor, which is why the row set was clustered here. 8 constituent phase 1 HV-RCTs are enumerated at compound level WITH per-study denominators (Table 1), so constituents_identifiable is "partial" rather than "no"; but the source gives no registry identifier for any of them, so NO constituent trial records were created and no NCT ids were asserted (hard rules 1, 3 and 6). A probe of ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-09-30 confirms that plausible phase 1 HV records exist for some of these compounds but cannot be matched 1:1 on the evidence available: e.g. NCT02414594 (IONIS-APO(a)-LRx, phase 1, healthy volunteers) lists enrolment 60 against Table 1's 58 for ISIS 681257, and NCT02709850 (IONIS-ANGPTL3-LRx, phase 1, healthy volunteers) lists 48 which matches Table 1's 48 for ISIS 703802 - one match and one mismatch is not a basis for asserting the mapping, so none is asserted. CROSS-CLUSTER OVERLAP WARNING: same integrated safety database as crooke2016-2moe-integrated-hv and the analysis curated in cluster_crooke2017_pooled; do not sum denominators across them.

studies.study_name: ORION-1 - A Placebo-controlled, Double-blind, Randomized Trial to Compare the Effect of Different Doses of ALN-PCSSC Given as Single or Multiple Subcutaneous Injections in Subjects With High Cardiovascular Risk and Elevated LDL-C (pre-specified platelet/immune safety analysis)
studies.design: randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group phase 2 dose-ranging trial with single-dose and double-dose (day 1 and day 90) starting regimens; the platelet, immune-cell, immune-marker and anti-drug-antibody results curated here are the trial's PRE-SPECIFIED safety analysis, reported in a separate publication
studies.indication: elevated LDL-C at high cardiovascular risk (atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, familial hypercholesterolaemia, diabetes)
studies.population: 501 patients at high cardiovascular risk with elevated LDL-C across six inclisiran regimens and two placebo groups
studies.n_enrolled: 501 (ClinicalTrials.gov actual enrolment, confirmed by the publication's 6068 analysed immunogenicity samples drawn from 501 patients and by the curated ADA row "1 of 501")
studies.n_analyzed_platelet: 501 as entered into the pre-specified safety analysis, with group sizes stated verbatim: single dose 200 mg n=60, 300 mg n=62, 500 mg n=66; double dose 100 mg n=62, 200 mg n=63, 300 mg n=61; placebo single dose n=65, placebo double dose n=62 (60+62+66+62+63+61+65+62 = 501). Per-group day-180 completer counts are not printed, so the day-180 medians in Table 1 may rest on slightly smaller denominators.
studies.dose_regimen: inclisiran 200, 300 or 500 mg SC once on day 1 (single-dose regimen), or 100, 200 or 300 mg SC on day 1 and day 90 (double-dose regimen); normal-saline placebo on the matching schedule
studies.duration: 180 days for the platelet/haematology endpoints; up to 360 days for the longitudinal platelet and anti-drug-antibody follow-up
studies.platelet_endpoint_basis: "At day 180, no significant alterations of platelet counts were observed in any of the dosing groups (change from baseline, SD: 200 mg: 0.8%; 300 mg: -0.5%; 500 mg: -1.8%; DD: 100 mg: 1.3%; 200 mg: -0.5%; 300 mg: 1.0%; no significant difference for any group as compared with placebo)." [Cardiovasc Res 2021;117:284-291, Abstract, "Methods and results"; the same values are tabulated in Table 1 "Changes of blood counts after 6-month treatment with Inclisiran", Platelets block, "Change median, %" row]. The analysis is pre-specified ("we present the pre-specified safety analysis from ORION-1 evaluating platelets, immune cells, immunological markers, antidrug antibodies"), so these are assessed negatives under a defined exposure and observation window, not absence of reporting (hard rule 5).
studies.verification_locus: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 record fetched 2026-09-30: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT02597127 -> orgStudyIdInfo.id "MDCO-PCS-15-01", officialTitle "A Placebo-controlled, Double-blind, Randomized Trial to Compare the Effect of Different Doses of ALN-PCSSC Given as Single or Multiple Subcutaneous Injections in Subjects With High Cardiovascular Risk and Elevated LDL-C", PHASE2, enrolment 501 ACTUAL, sponsor The Medicines Company, intervention ALN-PCSSC (otherNames "PCSK9 synthesis inhibitor", "Inclisiran"), eight arms matching the publication exactly (200/300/500 mg bi-annual single dose, 100/200/300 mg quarterly double dose, saline on each schedule). Publication verified via Europe PMC EXT_ID:32243492 -> Landmesser U, Haghikia A, Leiter LA, Wright RS, Kallend D, Wijngaard P, Stoekenbroek R, Kastelein JJ, Ray KK, "Effect of inclisiran, the small-interfering RNA against proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9, on platelets, immune cells, and immunological biomarkers: a pre-specified analysis from ORION-1", Cardiovasc Res 2021;117:284-291, doi 10.1093/cvr/cvaa077; the abstract's six percent-change values match the six curated dose-group rows one-for-one.
studies.notes: OUT OF COMPOUND for this cluster: inclisiran, not volanesorsen. It sits here because the same publication cross-cites the volanesorsen APPROACH and inotersen NEURO-TTR platelet findings as comparators. ONE TRIAL, not a pooled analysis: this is the pre-specified safety analysis of a single registered trial (hard rule 3 does not apply), so it is typed registered_trial and its 18 rows are dose-group cells of that one trial. CROSS-CLUSTER DEDUPLICATION WARNING: inclisiran also appears in cluster_other_regulatory via the Leqvio FDA NDA 214012 clinical review (SRC-C76E2B); if that review restates ORION-1 platelet data, those rows belong to THIS trial record (NCT02597127) and must not create a second inclisiran trial. The two TOLG258 rows from this same publication (TMSR1956, TMSR1957) are secondary citations of APPROACH and were assigned to volanesorsen-CS6, with the 45.5% discrepancy documented there.

unassignable.why: Secondary citation, in the Discussion of the ORION-1 safety paper (Cardiovasc Res 2021;117:284-291, ref 4), of Benson et al. NEURO-TTR (inotersen, N Engl J Med 2018;379:22-31): 1 fatal intracranial haemorrhage of 172 patients. NEURO-TTR is resolved in cluster_inotersen; re-asserting it here would double-count the trial (hard rule 2).
Same secondary citation of NEURO-TTR (inotersen): 3 serious adverse events of thrombocytopenia among 172 patients. Resolved in cluster_inotersen; not a separate evidence unit here (hard rule 2).

Crooke 2016 (Mol Ther 24:1771-1782) Discussion cross-reference to the then-still-blinded IONIS-TTRRx phase 3 programme - i.e. inotersen/NEURO-TTR, which is resolved as its own trial record in cluster_inotersen (PMID 29972757 / Tegsedi EPAR EMA/411876/2018). Creating a trial record here would double-count that trial (hard rule 2). The locus also gives no event count, no denominator and no dose.

Same Crooke 2016 Discussion paragraph: a pre-treatment disease-background statistic ('8% of patients entering the phase 3 trial with IONIS-TTRRx have grade 1 thrombocytopenia') with no denominator and no oligonucleotide exposure. It belongs to the IONIS-TTRRx/inotersen programme curated in cluster_inotersen, not to any volanesorsen study.

Crooke 2016 Discussion states only that 'severe thrombocytopenic events occurred in two placebo-controlled phase 3 studies with two different 2'MOE chimeric ASOs, IONIS-TTRRx and volanesorsen', with the trials still blinded and causality not established. The volanesorsen study is not named, and both CS6/APPROACH (NCT02211209) and CS16/COMPASS (NCT02300233) were ongoing placebo-controlled phase 3 volanesorsen studies at that time, so the row cannot be resolved to one trial without guessing (hard rule 1). No event count, denominator or dose is given.

notes:
SCOPE AND HEADLINE ANSWER. 239 curated measurement rows in this cluster resolve to 11 evidence units: 5 registered human trials (4 volanesorsen: CS2/NCT01529424, CS6-APPROACH/NCT02211209, CS16-COMPASS/NCT02300233, CS7-APPROACH-OLE/NCT02658175; plus 1 non-volanesorsen trial, inclisiran ORION-1/NCT02597127), 5 pooled/integrated analyses that are NOT trials (3 volanesorsen regulatory pools, 2 class-level Ionis phase 1 integrated analyses), and 1 label summary. 234 rows are assigned, 5 are unassignable. The 1002 'human_clinical' rows in the dataset are measurement cells, not trials: in this cluster alone, 89 rows resolve to the single APPROACH trial and 32 to the single COMPASS trial, mostly as dose-group, nadir-category, arm and individual-patient cells of one table each. 

IDENTIFIER MAPPING. Every sponsor study code in the system_model field mapped 1:1 to a registry record whose orgStudyIdInfo.id carries the same code, so none had to be inferred: ISIS 304801-CS2 = NCT01529424, ISIS 304801-CS6 = NCT02211209, ISIS 304801-CS7 = NCT02658175, ISIS 304801-CS16 = NCT02300233. All four were fetched individually from https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/<NCT> on 2026-09-30 and each returned the expected compound (volanesorsen / ISIS 304801 / IONIS-APOCIIIRx), phase, condition and arm structure. NCT02597127 was verified the same way for inclisiran ORION-1 and its eight arms match the publication's eight dose groups exactly. No registry identifier is asserted anywhere in this file that was not fetched and checked. 

PROGRAMME CONTEXT. The volanesorsen clinical programme is larger than the four trials that carry platelet rows here: the EPAR's tabular overview of clinical studies lists CS1 (phase 1 SAD/MAD, 25 volanesorsen + 8 placebo), CS13 (thorough QT, 52 subjects), CS2, CS4 (phase 2 in type 2 diabetes, 10 + 5), CS6, CS16 and CS7, and states 'A total of 7 clinical studies have been conducted with volanesorsen'; CS17/BROADEN (NCT02527343) and CS19 also exist. CS1, CS4, CS13, CS17 and CS19 carry no measurement rows in this cluster, so no records were created for them - their absence here is a gap in the measurement extraction, not evidence that platelets were not measured. 

CONVENTIONS. (1) registry_id and sponsor_protocol_id are set to the empty string on the six non-trial units (pooled analyses and the label summary) because no registry record exists for them - this is 'not applicable', distinct from 'TBD' which is used only where a value exists but could not be established from the sources reached. (2) 'TBD' appears in n_enrolled / n_analyzed_platelet only where the source prints no denominator: CS2's platelet denominator, the <50,000/mm3 cross-study tally, and the label warning. (3) NOT_REGISTERED is not used anywhere: every trial in this cluster is registered, and for the pooled analyses the question does not arise. 

DEDUPLICATION PERFORMED (hard rule 2). APPROACH is reported four times across the sources - NEJM 2019 (PMID 31390500), the Waylivra EPAR CS6 sections, the SmPC APPROACH paragraphs, and a secondary citation in the ORION-1 safety paper - and is recorded once. The SmPC open-label-extension paragraphs were folded into CS7 and the SmPC adverse-reaction table into the pooled FCS set rather than being left as free-floating label rows. NEURO-TTR (inotersen) is cross-cited by two of this cluster's sources but is resolved in cluster_inotersen, so no record was created for it here; four of the five unassignable rows are that cross-cluster case. 

OVERLAPPING DENOMINATORS (hard rule 7). The CS7 open-label extension shares 14 patients with CS6 and 3 with CS16, so its 67 (registry 68; label platelet denominator 66) is never added to its parents. The EPAR's own de-duplicated figure is the right one to use for 'how many FCS patients were exposed': 86 unique patients across CS6+CS7+CS16 (87 in the later label cut), not 33+67+5 = 105. Separately, the EPAR's pooled phase 3 percentages (e.g. thrombocytopenia 12.9%, platelet count decreased 14.4%) are CMH-adjusted by study and are NOT n/N - a downstream consumer that back-computes counts from them will be wrong. 

DEFECTS FOUND IN THE UNDERLYING ROWS. (a) TMSR1890 conflates two trials: the SmPC sentence it quotes reports 16% anti-drug-antibody positivity at 6 months (CS16) and 33% at 12 months (APPROACH); the row's value 33 belongs to APPROACH, the 16% element in effect_vs_control belongs to CS16, and the row should be split. (b) TMSR1957 carries 45.5% for confirmed platelet nadir <100,000/uL in APPROACH, a tertiary restatement equal to 15/33 that matches neither primary figure (EPAR 15/32 = 46.9%, NEJM 16/33 = 48%). (c) TMSR1788 and TMSR1790 are labelled as the CS16 '300 mg biweekly arm' but the EPAR attributes those mean changes to 'a selection of patients from the 300 mg biweekly group (n=15 of 27 treated during end of study)', not to the 50-patient arm. (d) The same endpoint in APPROACH differs by exactly one patient between the EPAR (24 and 15 of 32 evaluable) and the NEJM paper (25 and 16 of 33), and the EPAR narrative's own '24/33 ... (75%)' on p.92 is inconsistent with its Table 37 denominator of 32; none of these was silently reconciled. (e) The EPAR gives two different counts for CS7 discontinuations due to platelet decrease - 9 (p.103) and 6 (p.112). (f) Row TMSR424 in the Crooke 2016 set is a PLACEBO-arm row carrying thrombocytopenia_grade 2: the single platelet count below 75,000/uL among 750 healthy volunteers occurred on placebo, so any analysis that filters on grade without filtering dose_or_conc_value='0' will mis-attribute it to the drug class. 

CROSS-CLUSTER CAUTION. Two units here (crooke2016-2moe-integrated-hv, crooke2019-galnac3-integrated-hv) are class-level integrated analyses from the same Ionis integrated safety database as the analysis curated in cluster_crooke2017_pooled; subject-level overlap is likely, so these pools must not be counted as independent trials nor their denominators summed. Inclisiran ORION-1 may also be restated in the Leqvio FDA review curated in cluster_other_regulatory and must remain one trial. 

LIMITATIONS. EPAR Tables 38 (CS16 nadir categories), 22 and the EPAR figures are embedded bitmaps; their text could not be re-extracted from the PDF, so the CS16 per-category values were accepted as curated and the 25/50 arm denominators were inferred from the only split arithmetically consistent with the printed 2.00% and 6.00% cells together with the EPAR's own 'n=50 ... n=25' statement on p.112. The NEJM APPROACH paper and the Cardiovascular Research ORION-1 paper are subscription-only; their quoted loci were verified from the Europe PMC abstract records plus the curated page-level citations, not from the full texts. Supplementary Table S1 of Crooke 2016 and Supplementary Tables S5/S9 of Crooke 2019 were not retrieved, so the per-study identities behind the 15-trial and 8-trial pools, and the single-dose-cohort platelet denominators, remain unestablished.
